run.executedVia: Playwright runner, no browser: ServiceNow read over cnit and the Scripted REST API as sf.integration, Salesforce read over the sf CLI and anonymous Apex against the deployed classes. Every case reads both sides.

case.title: API budget consumption per journey

steps.text: Read the org limits — the same figure Setup shows as "API Requests, Last 24 Hours".

observations: Documentation correction: HANDOFF section 1 and both test-case files state a ~5,000 call daily budget. The org reports 15000. Every budget calculation in the pack is therefore conservative by a factor of 3.0, which is the safe direction to be wrong in, but the figure should be corrected.

The per-journey figure of ~45 calls cannot be measured in this pass: it requires executing one full end-to-end journey, which is a ONE-SHOT write case (TC-INT-027 and TC-INT-031). Measured here: the read-only pass costs well under 1% of the budget and can be re-run freely.
expected: Roughly 45 calls for one full end-to-end journey, about 1% of the daily budget.
No unexplained jump that would indicate an echo loop or a retry storm.
actual: Storage: 0 of 5 MB data, 0 of 20 MB files.
This read-only pass has itself made 5 sf calls so far.
case.verdictReason: Budget healthy: 410 of 15000 used, no sign of an echo loop or retry storm. Per-journey consumption not measured — needs a ONE-SHOT journey.
